476949.note: After desilting in 2023-24, this headwater pond / check dam held water +2.8 weeks a year compared with 10 similar untreated waterbodies within 20 km, over 2023-24 and 2024-25. That is within the range untreated waterbodies show by chance, so no change can be told apart. A change smaller than one season may not show in seasonal data. 4,158 m³ of silt was removed, about 0.06 m over its area. Across 1 desilted headwater ponds / check dams in Thane district, the average change is +2.8 weeks a year.
